functional_requirements: Customer can track delivery in real-time
Restaurant owners can manage their menu
Restaurant owners can view incoming orders
Restaurant owners can update order status
Delivery agents can receive order assignments
Delivery agents can update delivery status via a mobile app
Support for UPI, credit/debit cards, and cash on delivery
Availability on Android, iOS, and web
risks: Staying within the budget of 15 lakhs INR
Handling the expected scale of 1 lakh users within 6 months
Ensuring the security of the system
Managing the complexity of multiple payment options
assumptions: The client has the necessary infrastructure to support the system
The client has a clear understanding of the target audience and market
The client has a plan for marketing and promoting the platform
The development team will have access to the necessary resources and expertise
questions_to_client: Can you provide more information about the target audience and market?
What is the expected average order value and frequency of orders?
How will the restaurant owners and delivery agents be onboarded and trained?
What is the plan for handling customer support and feedback?
Are there any specific technology or infrastructure requirements or preferences?
